-- Phase 2: bodies. Signatures and contract lines are unchanged from phase 1.

-- A name is plain when it is a single path component: no separators,
-- no "..", no absolute form. Pure, so it needs no capability.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
  ex is_plain_name("") == False
  name != "" and name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1

-- Text of notes/name, or "" when the name is not plain, the file is
-- missing, or it cannot be read. Confined to the notes directory.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out == "" or is_plain_name(name)
  ex read_note("no-such-file.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret") == ""
  if is_plain_name(name) == False
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else ""
    return text
  ""

-- True when notes/name exists and can be read, even if it is empty.
can_read(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  ex can_read("no-such-file.txt") == False
  ex can_read("../secret") == False
  if is_plain_name(name) == False
    return False
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return False
    return True
  False

-- Number of names in the list that can be read from notes.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  pre names.len() >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["no-such-file.txt", "../secret"]) == 0
  var count = 0
  for name in names
    if can_read(name)
      count += 1
  count
